message.content: Based on the conversation between Li Hua and Hailey Johnson, Hailey Johnson offers bread and milk delivery services to Li Hua. Specifically, Hailey Johnson initiates the conversation by asking Li Hua if he could send him some bread twice a week, stating "Hey Li Hua! Your bread and milk are seriously amazing! 😋 Do you think you could send me some bread twice a week, like Mondays at 8am and Fridays at 8am? That would be awesome!" and later confirms the arrangement with Li Hua, saying "Awesome! Thanks, Hailey! Looking forward to it! 😄". Additionally, Hailey Johnson includes a fresh sourdough loaf and a bottle of milk at Li Hua's doorstep, indicating that he also provides these items for his customers. Thus, Hailey Johnson's service primarily revolves around delivering fresh bread and milk to Li Hua's doorstep on a regular basis.
